## Description

A small dinoflagellate (10–15 × 4–8 µm) of polar sea ice; cultured at 2 °C (0–6 °C). It swims with two
flagella in the brine channels and forms cysts in the ice.

## In the simulation

<!-- GENERATED:presence -->
Drops: `sea_ice` (weight 2); 10 individuals in a reference drop at weight 1.
<!-- /GENERATED -->

A phototactic flagellate of the `sea_ice` biome that encysts.
